_comment: UnboundBot — Alpaca PAPER execution config (Phase 6). dry_run=false means Freqtrade sends REAL orders to the endpoint below; the trader URL is overridden to paper-api.alpaca.markets so orders go to Alpaca PAPER (no real money). Keys authenticate OK (check_alpaca.py). Do NOT run until the owner approves paper order flow.
_warning: If the ccxt url override ever fails, orders could target live. Verify the resolved endpoint with check_alpaca.py before trading. Rotate the exposed keys.

exchange.name: alpaca
exchange._secrets_note: Keys are injected at runtime from D:\BOT\.env via FREQTRADE__EXCHANGE__KEY/SECRET by app/scripts/run_paper.py. Never hardcode here (this file is committed).
exchange._ft_has_note: Alpaca is not a Freqtrade-native exchange. Its ccxt fetch_ohlcv returns ONLY the current partial bar when called without a 'since' timestamp, so Freqtrade's default 'regular' refresh (since=None) yielded 1 candle -> 'Empty candle'. ohlcv_require_since=true forces Freqtrade to always compute a 'since' and take the historic-fetch path, which returns the full daily history needed for the EMA65/STD65 startup.
